title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the location of the point on the lower pendulum, which is xi = 3l.

title: Use of Coordinates
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly define the coordinates for both pendulums and their respective velocities.

title: Lagrangian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the Lagrangian correctly, including both kinetic and potential energy terms.

title: Normal Modes
description: Important Criteria: The student should identify and solve for the normal modes of the system accurately.

title: Horizontal Displacement Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly apply the condition for zero horizontal displacement in their solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations of motion or when applying conditions for zero displacement.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that could affect the solution.
